headline: China calls Amodei slowdown essay 'fearmongering'; coordination dips
body: A light day. China's Foreign Ministry dismissed Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei's essay urging a paced frontier and continued US chip curbs as 'fearmongering'. That is a small knock to Global Coordination, which trims Gatekeeper and nudges Self-Destruction up. Separately, 404 Media reported that contractors read real ChatGPT conversations under 'Project Lily', adding to Surveillance & Control and edging up 1984. Self-Destruction moved just ahead of Conquerors. Horizon Balance: -3.55.
movers_note: Gatekeeper -0.2, from China's rebuke of Amodei (-0.14) and fading earlier news (-0.04). Protector God -0.1, from fading earlier news (-0.05) and the Project Lily report (-0.04). 1984 +0.08, from the Project Lily report (+0.13) and fading earlier news (+0.03), partly offset by China's rebuke of Amodei (-0.08).
